# WandPress — LLM Context & Reference Guide (llm.txt)
> WordPress admin-inspired React component library and design system. Built with React 18/19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Radix UI.

## Package Details
- npm: wandpress (https://www.npmjs.com/package/wandpress)
- Repository: https://github.com/jonbuster/wandpress
- License: MIT
- Dual bundle: ESM (`dist/wandpress.js`) & CommonJS (`dist/wandpress.cjs`)
- Stylesheet: `wandpress/wandpress.css`
- TypeScript: Full typings included (`dist/index.d.ts`)

---

## Installation & Setup

```bash
npm install wandpress
# or
pnpm add wandpress
# or
yarn add wandpress
# or
bun add wandpress
```

In your main entry file or layout (e.g., `main.tsx`, `App.tsx`, `layout.tsx`):
```tsx
import 'wandpress/wandpress.css'
```

---

## Design System Tokens & Color Palette

WandPress faithfully mirrors the WordPress administration color palette:

- `wp-bg`: `#f0f0f1` — Page background
- `wp-surface`: `#ffffff` — Card / container surface
- `wp-surface-alt`: `#f6f7f7` — Table headers, panel footers, alternating rows
- `wp-border`: `#c3c4c7` — Standard borders
- `wp-border-light`: `#dcdcde` — Sub-dividers, table row separators
- `wp-text`: `#1d2327` — Primary body text
- `wp-muted`: `#646970` — Subtitles, hints, timestamps
- `wp-primary`: `#2271b1` — Core WordPress Blue
- `wp-primary-hover`: `#135e96` — Hover state for primary buttons and active links
- `wp-primary-light`: `#d0dff4` — Selected rows, secondary button hover
- `wp-success`: `#00a32a` (background: `#edfaef`)
- `wp-warning`: `#dba617` (background: `#fcf9e8`)
- `wp-danger`: `#d63638` (background: `#fde8e8`)
- `wp-info`: `#72aee6` (background: `#e5f0fb`)
- `wp-dark`: `#1d2327` — Hero banner, topbar, and sidebar background

Typography: System UI stack (`-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Oxygen-Sans, Ubuntu, Cantarell, "Helvetica Neue", sans-serif`), base font size `13px`.

---

## Component API Reference

All components are imported directly from `'wandpress'`:

### 1. Button
Variants match official WP button styles. Supports Radix `asChild` to wrap `<a>` links.
```tsx
import { Button } from 'wandpress'

// Primary (WordPress Blue)
<Button variant="primary" size="default" onClick={handleClick}>
  Save Changes
</Button>

// Secondary (White with WP blue border)
<Button variant="secondary" size="sm">
  Cancel
</Button>

// Danger (Red action)
<Button variant="danger">
  Move to Trash
</Button>

// Ghost / Link
<Button variant="ghost">Draft</Button>
<Button variant="link">Documentation →</Button>

// As link
<Button asChild variant="primary">
  <a href="/posts/new">Add New Post</a>
</Button>
```

### 2. Badge
Status badges with rounded pill styling.
```tsx
import { Badge } from 'wandpress'

<Badge variant="success">Published</Badge>
<Badge variant="warning">Pending Review</Badge>
<Badge variant="danger">Spam</Badge>
<Badge variant="info">Scheduled</Badge>
<Badge variant="primary">Admin</Badge>
<Badge variant="default">Draft</Badge>
```

### 3. Alert / Notice
Standard left-bordered WordPress administration notice.
```tsx
import { Alert } from 'wandpress'

<Alert variant="success" title="Post Published" dismissible onDismiss={() => {}}>
  Your post has been published. <a href="#">View post</a>
</Alert>

// Variants: 'default' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'error' | 'info'
```

### 4. Cards & CardAccordion
Panel cards and collapsible WordPress dashboard widgets.
```tsx
import { Card, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardContent, CardFooter, CardAccordion } from 'wandpress'

// Standard Card
<Card>
  <CardHeader>
    <CardTitle>Site Overview</CardTitle>
  </CardHeader>
  <CardContent>
    <p>Everything is running smoothly on version 6.4.</p>
  </CardContent>
  <CardFooter>
    <span>Updated 5 minutes ago</span>
  </CardFooter>
</Card>

// Collapsible WordPress Widget
<CardAccordion title="At a Glance" defaultOpen>
  <p>12 Posts, 4 Pages, 1 Comment</p>
</CardAccordion>
```

### 5. Dialog (Modal)
Accessible modal dialog built on Radix UI.
```tsx
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogTrigger,
  DialogContent,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogBody,
  DialogFooter,
  Button
} from 'wandpress'

<Dialog>
  <DialogTrigger asChild>
    <Button variant="primary">Open Modal</Button>
  </DialogTrigger>
  <DialogContent size="default"> {/* 'sm' | 'default' | 'lg' | 'xl' */}
    <DialogHeader>
      <DialogTitle>Confirm Action</DialogTitle>
    </DialogHeader>
    <DialogBody>
      <p>Are you sure you want to permanently delete this item?</p>
    </DialogBody>
    <DialogFooter>
      <Button variant="ghost">Cancel</Button>
      <Button variant="danger">Delete</Button>
    </DialogFooter>
  </DialogContent>
</Dialog>
```

### 6. Sheet / Drawer
Slide-in drawer panel with smooth entrance and exit animations.
```tsx
import {
  Sheet,
  SheetTrigger,
  SheetContent,
  SheetHeader,
  SheetTitle,
  SheetDescription,
  SheetFooter,
  Button
} from 'wandpress'

<Sheet>
  <SheetTrigger asChild>
    <Button variant="secondary">Open Drawer</Button>
  </SheetTrigger>
  <SheetContent side="right"> {/* 'right' | 'left' | 'top' | 'bottom' */}
    <SheetHeader>
      <SheetTitle>Quick Edit Post</SheetTitle>
      <SheetDescription>Modify post metadata directly.</SheetDescription>
    </SheetHeader>
    <div className="p-4 space-y-3">
      {/* Form fields */}
    </div>
    <SheetFooter>
      <Button variant="primary">Update</Button>
    </SheetFooter>
  </SheetContent>
</Sheet>
```

### 7. Form Controls
```tsx
import { Input, Textarea, Select, SelectTrigger, SelectValue, SelectContent, SelectItem, SwitchField, Checkbox, RadioGroup, RadioGroupItem } from 'wandpress'

// Text Input
<Input placeholder="Enter title..." inputSize="default" /> {/* 'sm' | 'default' | 'lg' */}

// Textarea
<Textarea placeholder="Post excerpt..." rows={4} />

// Select
<Select defaultValue="publish">
  <SelectTrigger className="w-[180px]">
    <SelectValue placeholder="Status" />
  </SelectTrigger>
  <SelectContent>
    <SelectItem value="publish">Published</SelectItem>
    <SelectItem value="draft">Draft</SelectItem>
    <SelectItem value="private">Private</SelectItem>
  </SelectContent>
</Select>

// Toggle Switch
<SwitchField
  label="Maintenance Mode"
  description="Display a splash screen to all visitors."
  checked={maintenance}
  onCheckedChange={setMaintenance}
/>

// Checkbox
<div className="flex items-center gap-2">
  <Checkbox id="sticky" checked={isSticky} onCheckedChange={setIsSticky} />
  <label htmlFor="sticky" className="text-[13px] text-wp-text">Stick this post to the front page</label>
</div>
```

### 8. Data Tables
WordPress admin list table with row hovering and alignment.
```tsx
import {
  Table,
  TableWrapper,
  TableHeader,
  TableBody,
  TableRow,
  TableHead,
  TableCell
} from 'wandpress'

<TableWrapper>
  <Table>
    <TableHeader>
      <TableRow>
        <TableHead>Title</TableHead>
        <TableHead>Author</TableHead>
        <TableHead>Categories</TableHead>
        <TableHead>Date</TableHead>
      </TableRow>
    </TableHeader>
    <TableBody>
      <TableRow>
        <TableCell className="font-semibold text-wp-primary">Hello World!</TableCell>
        <TableCell>admin</TableCell>
        <TableCell>Uncategorized</TableCell>
        <TableCell className="text-wp-muted text-[12px]">Published 2026/09/09</TableCell>
      </TableRow>
    </TableBody>
  </Table>
</TableWrapper>
```

### 9. Navigation (Tabs, Topbar, Sidebar, Breadcrumb, Pagination)
```tsx
import { Tabs, TabsList, TabsTrigger, TabsContent, Pagination } from 'wandpress'

// Tabs
<Tabs defaultValue="general">
  <TabsList>
    <TabsTrigger value="general">General</TabsTrigger>
    <TabsTrigger value="writing">Writing</TabsTrigger>
    <TabsTrigger value="reading">Reading</TabsTrigger>
  </TabsList>
  <TabsContent value="general">General settings content</TabsContent>
  <TabsContent value="writing">Writing settings content</TabsContent>
</Tabs>

// Pagination
<Pagination
  currentPage={currentPage}
  totalPages={totalPages}
  totalItems={48}
  itemsPerPage={10}
  onPageChange={(page) => setCurrentPage(page)}
/>
```

### 10. Toasts
```tsx
import { useToast } from 'wandpress'

function MyComponent() {
  const { toast } = useToast()

  const handleSave = () => {
    toast({
      title: 'Settings Saved',
      description: 'Your changes have been saved to the database.',
      variant: 'success', // 'default' | 'success' | 'danger' | 'warning' | 'info'
    })
  }

  return <Button onClick={handleSave}>Save</Button>
}
```

### 11. Full Admin Page Templates
Pre-built, production-ready full administration screens ready to drop into your app:
```tsx
import { PostsTableTemplate, SettingsScreenTemplate } from 'wandpress'

// Interactive Posts management view with filters, search, bulk actions, and quick edit
<PostsTableTemplate />

// Complete tabbed Settings view with toggles, form fields, and feedback toasts
<SettingsScreenTemplate />
```

---

## Best Practices for LLMs Generating WandPress Code

1. Always import styles: Ensure `import 'wandpress/wandpress.css'` is present in your app layout or entry point.
2. Consistent Spacing: WordPress admin interfaces favor dense, functional layouts:
   - Use `bg-wp-bg` (`#f0f0f1`) as outer page canvas.
   - Use `bg-white border border-wp-border rounded shadow-sm` for cards/panels.
   - Text size defaults to `text-[13px]`, headings `text-[20px] font-bold text-wp-text`.
3. Button Hierarchy:
   - Use `<Button variant="primary">` for primary form submission / creation actions.
   - Use `<Button variant="secondary">` for secondary actions, filters, and standard operations.
   - Use `<Button variant="danger">` for destructive actions (Delete, Trash).
4. Links in Buttons: When rendering an `<a>` inside a `<Button>`, always pass `asChild`:
   ```tsx
   <Button asChild variant="primary">
     <a href="/target">Navigate</a>
   </Button>
   ```
